narration:0:1523506001:0.text: You cast bind magic on Aurelin.
narration:0:1523506001:0.source_cn: 你用束缚魔法困住了奥勒留
narration:0:1523506001:0.male: You cast bind magic on Aurelin.
narration:0:1523506001:0.female: You cast bind magic on Aurelin.

narration:1:1523506002:0.text: The herbalist seizes the opportunity to escape, and the guards swiftly move in to protect her.
narration:1:1523506002:0.source_cn: 被挟持的学者趁机逃脱，被护卫们保护起来

say:6:1523506004:0.text: You despicable mage... How dare you sneak up on me!
say:6:1523506004:0.source_cn: 卑鄙的魔法师……你竟敢偷袭！
say:6:1523506004:0.male: You despicable mage... How dare you sneak up on me!
say:6:1523506004:0.female: You despicable mage... How dare you sneak up on me!

choice_prompt:7:1523506004.text: You despicable mage... How dare you sneak up on me!
choice_prompt:7:1523506004.source_cn: 卑鄙的魔法师……你竟敢偷袭！
choice_prompt:7:1523506004.male: You despicable mage... How dare you sneak up on me!
choice_prompt:7:1523506004.female: You despicable mage... How dare you sneak up on me!

say:9:1523506006:0.text: You think no one else will oppose you once I'm gone?
say:9:1523506006:0.source_cn: 你以为没有我，就不会有其他人反抗你，你就能安安稳稳地坐...

say:10:1523506007:0.text: Can you lead an army? Have you ever killed a Wildborn? No! You're just a clueless child! You don't deserve to be the Regulus!
say:10:1523506007:0.source_cn: 你懂怎么带领军队吗？你知道怎么杀死兽人吗？不！你只是一...

say:12:1523506009:1.text: There will be no more traitors like you.

say:13:1523506010:1.text: You don't know what the people truly want, but I do.
say:13:1523506010:1.source_cn: 你不知道呼临城的大家想要什么，但我知道。

say:14:1523506011:1.text: I'll give my all to make sure they live well.
say:14:1523506011:1.source_cn: 我会尽我所能，给大家想要的，让呼临的民众都过上好日子。

say:15:1523506012:1.text: So, you'll be the last traitor I ever face.
say:15:1523506012:1.source_cn: 所以，不会有你说的那一天。

say:17:1523506014:1.text: Aurelin! You have lied, incited rebellion, injured the herbalist, and deliberately obstructed our search for new crops.
say:17:1523506014:1.source_cn: ——奥勒留！你说谎，让军队反叛；又伤害无辜的学者，妨碍...

say:18:1523506015:1.text: I hereby sentence you for treason and order your immediate imprisonment!
say:18:1523506015:1.source_cn: 因此——我判你犯谋逆罪，立刻投牢！

say:19:1523506016:1.text: Your fate will be decided later! For now, we must focus on the bitter corn research.
say:19:1523506016:1.source_cn: 至于怎么处理……呃，之后再说！现在苦苞穗的事最重要。

say:20:1523506017:1.text: Guards, lock him in a cell. Make sure he gets no food for three days, so he knows what hunger feels like.
say:20:1523506017:1.source_cn: 护卫，把他关进牢里。三天不许给他吃的，让他也尝尝饥荒时...

say:27:1523506019:0.text: I sounded commanding just now, wouldn't you say?
say:27:1523506019:0.source_cn: 怎么样，我是不是很有魄力？

say:29:1523506021:1.text: Well, I've gained some experience after all this time.
say:29:1523506021:1.source_cn: 当然，我都当领主这么久了，总该有点长进嘛。

say:30:1523506022:1.text: Oh, we should <style="highlight">check on that herbalist</style>. She must be terrified!

say:31:1523506023:1.text: We owe her an apology for the distress she's endured.
say:31:1523506023:1.source_cn: 嗯，这的确是我们的过失，理应向她赔礼道歉。

choice:7:1:2.text: Despicable? Coming from a traitor like you?
choice:7:1:2.male: Despicable? Coming from a traitor like you?
choice:7:1:2.female: Despicable? Coming from a traitor like you?

choice:7:2:3.text: You should have watched your back.
choice:7:2:3.male: You should have watched your back.
choice:7:2:3.female: You should have watched your back.

say:0:1523507001:0.text: Let's talk to her about bitter corn.
say:0:1523507001:0.source_cn: 走吧，去和那位年轻的植物学者聊聊苦苞穗改良的事。
say:0:1523507001:0.male: Let's talk to her about bitter corn.
say:0:1523507001:0.female: Let's talk to her about bitter corn.

say:2:1523508001:0.text: Phew... I'm lucky to be alive...
say:2:1523508001:0.source_cn: 呼……总算……总算捡回了一条命……

say:3:1523508002:1.text: I had no idea Halia would be this dangerous after the war. Maybe I shouldn't have come...
say:3:1523508002:1.source_cn: 呼临城……真是太可怕了！早知道战争后呼临城大乱，我就不...

say:4:1523508003:0.source_cn: 咳嗯……外来的学者，你好！我是呼临城的领主。

say:5:1523508004:1.text: We've got everything set for the bitter corn research—the data, seeds, and field.
say:5:1523508004:1.source_cn: 关于之前提到的苦苞穗改良的研究，所有的资料、种子和实验...

say:6:1523508005:1.text: If you wish, you may begin the research at any time!
say:6:1523508005:1.source_cn: 如果你愿意的话，随时可以开始研究！

say:8:1523508007:1.text: Excellent! You'll be paid handsomely... Huh? You... are out?
say:8:1523508007:1.source_cn: 很好！呼临城会以最高待遇……啊？你、你不愿意？

say:9:1523508008:1.text: That traitor almost killed me! I don't want to spend a second more here!
say:9:1523508008:1.source_cn: 我刚到你们呼临城，就被那个谋逆的家伙绑架，差点丢了性命...

say:10:1523508009:1.text: I'm no longer interested in the research. I'm heading back to Sylane now!
say:10:1523508009:1.source_cn: 你说的那个研究我不想做了，我现在只想回希莱城！

say:14:1523508012:1.text: Your master, Paeon, is an old friend of mine. He told me you were his most talented student.
say:14:1523508012:1.source_cn: 你的老师，派翁，他是我的老友，经常和我提起你，说你是他...

say:15:1523508013:1.text: Here's the badge your master gave to his students. You should recognize it.
say:15:1523508013:1.source_cn: 这是你老师分发给学生的徽章，你应该认得。

say:16:1523508014:1.text: The evergreen badge... It's indeed from my master.
say:16:1523508014:1.source_cn: 冬青徽章……果然是老师的东西。

say:17:1523508015:0.text: Has Master Paeon moved to Halia? No wonder he hasn't been responding to my letters...
say:17:1523508015:0.source_cn: 派翁老师搬到呼临城来了吗？难怪我往他在图塔镇的地址寄信...

say:19:1523508016:1.text: ... Zan, your master and classmates have most likely perished in the disaster caused by the fallen God of Harvest.
say:19:1523508016:1.source_cn: ……扎莱，你的老师和同学，大概率已经在丰饶神堕落带来的...

narration:21:1523508018:0.text: After explaining the ins and outs, Bakis hands Paeon's letter and research notes to Zan.
narration:21:1523508018:0.source_cn: 比博解释了前因后果，将派翁的信与研究笔记一并递给了扎莱

narration:22:1523508019:0.text: Zan looks grief-stricken as she flips through the notes...
narration:22:1523508019:0.source_cn: 扎莱翻阅着笔记，她的神态变得僵硬、哀伤……

narration:23:1523508020:0.text: All of you wait for her to finish reading in silence.
narration:23:1523508020:0.source_cn: 你们没有出声催促她，静静等待她阅读完老师最后的笔记
narration:23:1523508020:0.male: All of you wait for her to finish reading in silence.
narration:23:1523508020:0.female: All of you wait for her to finish reading in silence.

say:24:1523508021:0.text: Can't believe the God of Harvest destroyed Tuttleton... Even my master, such a devoted worshipper, was...
say:24:1523508021:0.source_cn: 丰饶神竟然摧毁了图塔镇……老师那么虔诚地信仰着丰饶神，...

say:25:1523508022:1.text: <style="highlight">Completing the bitter corn research</style> was Paeon's final wish.

say:26:1523508023:1.text: I know you feel unsafe, but under Regulus Abundius' leadership, the incident earlier will not happen again.
say:26:1523508023:1.source_cn: 我知道你并不信任现在的呼临城，但我向你保证，在阿邦德殿...

say:27:1523508024:0.text: Would you reconsider and stay here to carry out your master's last wish?
say:27:1523508024:0.source_cn: 能否再给呼临城一次机会，继续苦苞穗的改良，实现派翁的遗愿？

say:28:1523508025:0.text:
... If this is my master's wish...
... Alright, I'll do it.
say:28:1523508025:0.source_cn: ……如果这就是老师的愿望……\n……好吧，我会的。

say:29:1523508026:1.text: Great! I'll arrange two... no, three—three guards to escort you!
say:29:1523508026:1.source_cn: 太好了！我向你保证，一定会安排两个……不，三个！三个护...

say:30:1523508027:1.text: I don't think that's necessary, but I do need some extra hands for the research.
say:30:1523508027:1.source_cn: 我用不着那么多护卫。不过，我确实需要你们帮我再找点人。

say:31:1523508028:1.text: I've looked through the research notes. While the basic framework is there, the experiments lack the necessary details.
say:31:1523508028:1.source_cn: 我看了老师的笔记，虽然研究框架已经搭好，但各项实验都缺...

say:32:1523508029:1.text: I can't do this alone, so I'll need your help to recruit more scholars.
say:32:1523508029:1.source_cn: 单凭我一个人，没法完成老师的改良计划。我需要你们帮忙召...

say:33:1523508030:1.text: No problem! I'll issue a decree right away to gather all the scholars in Halia!
say:33:1523508030:1.source_cn: 没问题，我马上就下令，召集全城的学者，都参与这项研究！

say:35:1523508032:1.text: ... I should thank you, on behalf of my master.

say:36:1523508033:1.text: He'd be thrilled to see the bitter corn improving so many lives...
say:36:1523508033:1.source_cn: 如果他改良的苦苞穗能拯救很多人，他一定会很高兴的……

narration:37:1523508034:0.text: Abundius arranges for several guards to escort Zan to her lodging.
narration:37:1523508034:0.source_cn: 在阿邦德的安排下，扎莱跟随护卫前往她的住处

say:40:1523508035:0.text: Phew... I'm relieved she said yes.

say:41:1523508036:0.text: I hope the research will yield results soon...
say:41:1523508036:0.source_cn: 不知道野生作物的改良研究什么时候才能成功，让呼临不再受...

say:43:1523508038:1.text: I foresee many hurdles in the research, with the God of Harvest still standing. However, on the bright side, at least no one can use food as an excuse to pressure you anymore.
say:43:1523508038:1.source_cn: 丰饶堕神还在，恐怕苦苞穗的改良会遇到不少困难。但至少，...

say:44:1523508039:0.text: I believe you will lead Halia to a brighter future.
say:44:1523508039:0.source_cn: 我相信，您会领导呼临迎来更好的明天。

say:45:1523508040:1.text: I will... We owe a big one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:45:1523508040:1.male: I will... We owe a big one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:45:1523508040:1.female: I will... We owe a big one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

choice_prompt:46:1523508040.text: I will... We owe a big one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
choice_prompt:46:1523508040.male: I will... We owe a big one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
choice_prompt:46:1523508040.female: I will... We owe a big one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:47:1523508042:0.text: I hope that the next time you visit Halia, you'll see the people living a life free from war and disaster.
say:47:1523508042:0.source_cn: 希望下次你来呼临的时候，能看到人们安居乐业的场景。不再...
say:47:1523508042:0.male: I hope that the next time you visit Halia, you'll see the people living a life free from war and disaster.
say:47:1523508042:0.female: I hope that the next time you visit Halia, you'll see the people living a life free from war and disaster.

say:48:1523508043:0.text: Halia will become a wonderful place to live!
say:48:1523508043:0.source_cn: 一定会是个很美好、很幸福的地方！
say:48:1523508043:0.male: Halia will become a wonderful place to live!
say:48:1523508043:0.female: Halia will become a wonderful place to live!

say:49:1523508044:1.text: No more disasters, no more war... What a beautiful wish.
say:49:1523508044:1.source_cn: 不再有天灾，也不再有战争……多么美好的一个心愿。

say:50:1523508045:1.text: While Abundius and Bakis are optimistic about the bitter corn research, you know that suppressing—or even removing—the God of Harvest's curse is an uphill battle.
say:50:1523508045:1.source_cn: 阿邦德和比博乐观地期待着苦苞穗能得到改良，但你知道丰饶...
say:50:1523508045:1.male: While Abundius and Bakis are optimistic about the bitter corn research, you know that suppressing—or even removing—the God of Harvest's curse is an uphill battle.
say:50:1523508045:1.female: While Abundius and Bakis are optimistic about the bitter corn research, you know that suppressing—or even removing—the God of Harvest's curse is an uphill battle.

say:51:1523508046:1.text: Perhaps, <style="highlight">the Halians are destined to face an intense clash with the God of Harvest</style> before they can embrace a brighter future...
say:51:1523508046:1.source_cn: 也许，在呼临迎接光明的未来之前，<style=high...

say:52:1523508047:1.text: You are not sure if you will be part of the battle, but you believe mortals will prevail in the end.
say:52:1523508047:1.source_cn: 你不知道自己是否还有机会再参与到这场大战之中，但你相信...
say:52:1523508047:1.male: You are not sure if you will be part of the battle, but you believe mortals will prevail in the end.
say:52:1523508047:1.female: You are not sure if you will be part of the battle, but you believe mortals will prevail in the end.

choice:46:1:2.text: Hey, I'm the best mage you've ever known.
choice:46:1:2.source_cn: 谁让我是最厉害的魔法师呢
choice:46:1:2.male: Hey, I'm the best mage you've ever known.
choice:46:1:2.female: Hey, I'm the best mage you've ever known.

say:5:1523501003:1.text: Well, I have good reason to be—we've found an herbalist!
say:5:1523501003:1.source_cn: 因为今天护卫传来了好消息——总算找到合适的植物学者了！
say:5:1523501003:1.male: Well, I have good reason to be—we've found an herbalist!
say:5:1523501003:1.female: Well, I have good reason to be—we've found an herbalist!

say:6:1523501005:1.text: There aren't any locals fit for the task, but I got a reply from Sylane. A scholar there is interested in helping with our research.
say:6:1523501005:1.source_cn: 呼临城内没有合适的学者，但前几天希莱城给我回信，说有一...

say:7:1523501006:1.text: Let's see... The scholar will be arriving in just a couple of days!
say:7:1523501006:1.source_cn: 我算算……这位学者现在应该已经在来呼临城的路上了，用不...

say:8:1523501007:1.text: Once the research is completed, the protests will naturally die down.
say:8:1523501007:1.source_cn: 等到苦苞穗改良工作全部完成，抗议的问题将会迎刃而解。

say:9:1523501008:0.text: Peace will finally return to Halia for good...
say:9:1523501008:0.source_cn: 呼临终于要迎来长久的稳定了……

say:13:1523501009:1.text: Regulus! There's an emergency outside the city!
say:13:1523501009:1.source_cn: ——殿下！报告殿下！城外出现了紧急情况！

say:14:1523501010:0.source_cn: 不要慌慌张张的。怎么回事？

say:15:1523501011:0.text: It's... Councilman Aurelin. He's rallied an army and is threatening to attack the city <style="highlight">unless you step down</style>.
say:15:1523501011:0.source_cn: 是……奥勒留议事官。他在城外聚集士兵，扬言要用武力强攻...

say:16:1523501012:0.text: The rest of us have followed the captain to the city gate, but we're outnumbered... We... might not be able to hold much longer!
say:16:1523501012:0.source_cn: 队长已经带着卫队到了城门，但对面人数太多，恐怕……恐怕...

say:22:1523501016:0.text: Regulus, please stay here while I...
say:22:1523501016:0.source_cn: 殿下，您先留在此处，我去城外——

say:24:1523501017:1.text: Freeze! This is the Regulus' chamber! How dare you...
say:24:1523501017:1.source_cn: 不许动！前方是领主殿下的居所，你们怎敢——

say:35:1523501019:0.source_cn: 懦弱无能的领主，交出领主之位！

say:36:1523501020:0.text: I'll seize the city by force if you resist!
say:36:1523501020:0.source_cn: 若再不从，我将带兵攻下此处！

say:38:1523501022:0.source_cn: 奥勒留，你带兵攻城，是谋逆重罪！

say:39:1523501023:0.text: This is your final warning! As your colleague for decades, if you stand down now, I can persuade the Regulus to spare your life!
say:39:1523501023:0.source_cn: 看在这么多年同僚的情面上，我最后警告你一次，就此收手！...

say:40:1523501024:1.text: You ignorant fool! No one can stop me from saving Halia!
say:40:1523501024:1.source_cn: 愚昧！任何人都休想阻止我拯救呼临！

say:41:1523501025:1.text: Save Halia?! You're doing the exact opposite of it!
say:41:1523501025:1.source_cn: 什么拯救！你才是想摧毁呼临！

say:42:1523501026:1.text: I've found an herbalist who can help us modify the bitter corn.
say:42:1523501026:1.source_cn: 我已经找到了合适的学者，只需要一段时间就能完成苦苞穗的...

say:43:1523501027:1.text: If everything goes well, the Wildborn will lose their leverage over us through food, and you'll have no reason to protest!
say:43:1523501027:1.source_cn: 食物不会再成为雅库伯尔牵制呼临的手段，停战合约的弊端也...

say:44:1523501028:1.text: Retreat now, Aurelin, while you still can!
say:44:1523501028:1.source_cn: 退兵吧，奥勒留，趁你还有回头的余地！

say:46:1523501030:1.text: Bakis, you're as rigid as ever.
say:46:1523501030:1.source_cn: 比博，你果然永远都是这么顽固古板。

say:47:1523501031:1.text: If I retreat now, then what? Go back to serving a naive child and carrying out his absurd policies? I'm done playing that game.
say:47:1523501031:1.source_cn: 就算我现在退兵，之后又如何？继续和你一起扮演愚蠢的臣子...

say:48:1523501032:1.text: Herennus had been wise his whole life, but lost his clarity on his deathbed! Abundius isn't a worthy successor!
say:48:1523501032:1.source_cn: 赫伦尼英明一世，死时却犯了糊涂！从一开始，阿邦德就不配...

say:49:1523501033:1.text: When he hesitated to wage war against the Wildborn, he proved himself unfit for the title!
say:49:1523501033:1.source_cn: ——早在他犹犹豫豫，不愿对兽人开战时，他就该让位了！

choice_prompt:50:1523501033.text: When he hesitated to wage war against the Wildborn, he proved himself unfit for the title!
choice_prompt:50:1523501033.source_cn: ——早在他犹犹豫豫，不愿对兽人开战时，他就该让位了！

say:51:1523501034:1.text: Indeed, and I stand by my decision!
say:51:1523501034:1.male: Indeed, and I stand by my decision!
say:51:1523501034:1.female: Indeed, and I stand by my decision!

say:52:1523501036:1.text: Count yourself lucky to have a student like Perseus! If it weren't for him, I'd have taken over Halia long ago!
say:52:1523501036:1.source_cn: 要不是比博你教出了珀尔修斯这个好学生，以一己之力统率军...

say:53:1523501037:1.text: Now that Perseus is dead, no one can stand in my way anymore!
say:53:1523501037:1.source_cn: 现在好了，珀尔修斯死了！再也没有人能骑在我头上！

say:54:1523501038:1.text: I bow to no one—not you, Bakis, nor Abundius!
say:54:1523501038:1.source_cn: 你——比博！还有他——阿邦德！谁也别妄想再压我一头！

say:55:1523501039:1.text: Just as I expected, the truce agreement is nothing but your excuse to stage a rebellion.
say:55:1523501039:1.source_cn: 果真如此……抗议停战合约，果然只是一个幌子、一个借口。

say:56:1523501040:1.text: You've been <style="highlight">eyeing the throne</style> all along!

say:57:1523501041:1.text: My father trusted you so much... How could you seize his city?!

say:22:1523503017:0.text: I've given my all as Herennus' right-hand man, and I didn't mind when he chose to pass his title to a child...
